purpose: Real independent reviewer evidence; exact input digests identify historical/current candidate bytes. No semantic completeness claim.
model_process: Installed Codex CLI with native enforcement; no process double.

cases.task: Review the current implementation of independent review and task-gap handling against the complete admitted Service and Shared Specs. Inspect the granted implementation files and scoped changes, prioritizing review.py, scoped_operations.py, change_worktree.py and test_review.py. Check separate read-only modes, input/version identity, result validation, required review gates, gap persistence/dedup/resume and Domain aggregation. Report concrete behavior or permission defects with reproducible triggers. Read relevant files by absolute path beneath /tmp/concorde-domain-scopes-edit. No edits or test execution. Distinguish coverage limits from missing necessary contracts; do not infer unadmitted provider behavior.

data.answer: Found two concrete defects: failed policy previews persist review state, and standalone task generation can advance despite a failed required Spec review. Assessment used static inspection; no tests were executed.

findings.affected_task: Preview review permissions without modifying project state
findings.contract: Describe-policy must not launch agents or mutate project state, including review persistence.
findings.problem: The exception handler unconditionally persists an incomplete report, including during describe-policy. Request a review preview with initialized outer enforcement but no verified outer sandbox: rendering fails under the admitted renderer contract, then this handler writes review and execution artifacts. In a managed change it can also replace required review evidence and invalidate readiness. Guard failure persistence by execute mode.

findings.affected_task: Generate tasks from an existing plan after a required Spec review becomes blocking
findings.contract: Required review failure blocks advancement; dependent planning and task steps must pause.
findings.problem: Standalone tasks checks plan freshness but never checks the required Spec review. After a standard loop has saved a plan, run a same-intent standalone Spec review that reports a blocking gap, then invoke concorde-tasks with unchanged Spec bytes. The plan remains current, and stage checks only gaps in the tasks phase, so task generation runs and can save tasks despite the open spec-review blocker. The review gate in plan() does not protect this entry point. Enforce the required Spec review before dependent task generation.

representative_tasks: Launch separate read-only Spec and code reviewers with scoped changes
Validate review identities, findings, gaps and completion status
Reuse reviews only for current inputs and intact artifacts
Preview review policy when enforcement admission fails
Resume standard and fast loops with persistent required reviews
Persist, deduplicate and resolve task gaps after accepted repairs
Generate standalone tasks after a required Spec review blocks
Aggregate Domain component reviews and verify readiness and delivery gates
